decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to efficiently ramp up mana with artifacts and control the board with Chalice of the Void while utilizing card advantage and powerful artifact synergy to overwhelm the opponent quickly. By utilizing cards like Urza's Saga, Emry, Lurker of the Loch, and Sai, Master Thopterist, the deck is able to generate value and create an aggressive board presence that can be difficult for the opponent to deal with. This deck aims to be proactive and fast, utilizing the power of artifacts to win the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

This deck utilizes a combination of powerful creatures and spells to ramp up mana quickly and control the game. By using cards like Green Sun's Zenith, Natural Order, and Gaea's Cradle, the deck can quickly put out threats like Craterhoof Behemoth and Grist, the Hunger Tide. Additionally, cards like Snuff Out and Fiend Artisan help to disrupt the opponent's game plan while establishing a dominant board presence. The inclusion of cards like Collector Ouphe and Allosaurus Shepherd provides additional disruption against artifact and blue-heavy decks, making this deck a versatile and formidable control archetype.

The main concept of the deck is to control the game with disruptive cards like Thoughtseize, Hymn to Tourach, and Force of Will, while powering out a big threat like Death's Shadow or Murktide Regent. The deck also aims to apply early pressure with cards like Street Wraith and Baleful Strix to quickly close out the game. Additionally, the deck includes a versatile card like Dress Down and has a solid mana base with fetch lands and dual lands to support its aggressive game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to generate a large amount of mana quickly through cards like Dark Ritual and Lion's Eye Diamond, and then cast multiple spells in a single turn to build up storm count. The deck also includes cards like Ad Nauseam and Tendrils of Agony to finish opponents off once a high enough storm count has been reached. The deck also includes cards like Veil of Summer and Thoughtseize to protect the combo and disrupt opponent's strategies. The goal of the deck is to win the game in one explosive turn.

The deck focuses on utilizing a variety of control elements such as counterspells, removal, and card draw to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. It also includes powerful creatures and spells to generate value and advantage over time. The inclusion of Yorion as a companion allows for additional value through blinking permanents. The mana base is carefully crafted to support the diverse range of colors needed for the deck's spells and abilities, while also including utility lands to further enhance its control and resource management capabilities.

This deck focuses on utilizing the Aluren combo to play creatures for free and generate value. The deck includes multiple ways to find Aluren, protect the combo pieces with Force of Will, and disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Endurance and Abrupt Decay. The creatures in the deck provide card advantage, removal, and tempo advantage, allowing the deck to control the game while setting up the combo. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the different mana requirements of the deck while maximizing consistency and flexibility.

The main concept of this deck is to use Cephalid Illusionist in combination with Nomads en-Kor to mill through your library quickly, putting cards like Narcomoeba and Thassa's Oracle into the graveyard. This sets up for a quick win condition with Thassa's Oracle or Dread Return. The deck also incorporates other combo pieces like Stoneforge Mystic and Kaldra Compleat for additional threats. The deck runs disruptive elements like Force of Will and Daze to protect the combo while using card selection tools like Brainstorm and Ponder to find key pieces.

The main concept of the deck is to assemble the combo of Painter's Servant and Grindstone to mill the opponent's entire deck. The deck utilizes cards like Goblin Engineer and Goblin Welder to find and recur the combo pieces, while also using disruption like Pyroblast and Red Elemental Blast to protect the combo. Additionally, the deck includes mana acceleration in the form of Lotus Petal and Simian Spirit Guide to facilitate the combo quickly. The deck aims to quickly establish control and win the game through the powerful synergy of Painter's Servant and Grindstone.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the Cephalid combo pieces, which consist of Cephalid Illusionist, Nomads en-Kor, and a discard outlet like Cabal Therapy. By milling the library with Cephalid Illusionist's ability, the player can put Narcomoeba and Thassa's Oracle into play, winning the game through the Oracle's "win the game" ability. The deck also utilizes counterspells like Force of Will and Daze to protect the combo, and has disruption tools like Cabal Therapy. Urza's Saga is used to tutor up key artifacts like Shuko and Kaldra Compleat.

The main concept of this deck is to use the card Doomsday as the central combo piece, allowing the player to set up their library in a specific order to win the game. This deck focuses on fast mana acceleration and card selection to efficiently find and play Doomsday, while protecting the combo with disruptive spells like Force of Will and Thoughtseize. Thassa's Oracle serves as the win condition once the combo is executed. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and win the game in a single turn, providing a powerful and efficient strategy in the Legacy format.

The main focus of this deck is to apply early pressure on the opponent by playing disruptive cards like Trinisphere and Chalice of the Void while ramping into powerful threats such as Legion Warboss and Goblin Rabblemaster. The deck aims to lockdown the opponent's non-basic lands with Blood Moon and create a board presence that is difficult to deal with. The inclusion of dragons like Laelia, the Blade Reforged and Fury provide additional aggressive options, while also utilizing cards like Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide for efficient mana acceleration. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent quickly and close out games before they can stabilize.

This Legacy 1 vs 1 Goblins deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a swarm of aggressive creatures. The key strategy is to utilize cards like Goblin Lackey to cheat out powerful Goblins early in the game, while also using cards like Mogg War Marshal and Goblin Matron to maintain card advantage. By combining creatures with disruptive abilities like Goblin Cratermaker and Pashalik Mons with burn spells like Pyrokinesis, the deck aims to keep the opponent on the back foot and secure a fast victory.

The deck focuses on using Show and Tell and Omniscience to cheat powerful creatures like Emrakul and Griselbrand into play, allowing for explosive plays and game-winning combos. Additionally, the deck includes protection spells like Force of Will and Veil of Summer to ensure that the combo pieces can be resolved safely. The deck also includes cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder to dig for combo pieces and manipulate the top of the deck. Cunning Wish provides additional flexibility and utility in finding answers or additional combo pieces from the sideboard.

This deck focuses on controlling the board through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and powerful planeswalkers. It aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while deploying threats like True-Name Nemesis and Stoneforge Mystic to apply pressure. The deck also utilizes cards like Back to Basics to slow down opponents reliant on non-basic lands. Overall, the key concept of the deck is to establish board control and outvalue the opponent through efficient and versatile cards.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly generate mana with ritual spells and artifacts, using various baubles and talismans to dig for combo pieces. The goal is to set up a lethal storm turn, with the key card being Tendrils of Agony, which deals damage for each spell cast during the turn. The deck runs disruption in the form of discard spells like Duress and Thoughtseize, as well as Cabal Therapy to disrupt the opponent's hand. The deck also utilizes Urza's Saga to search for key artifacts and lands to further enable the combo.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly generate mana with cards like Chrome Mox, Lion's Eye Diamond, and Dark Ritual, allowing the player to cast powerful combo spells like Ad Nauseam and Tendrils of Agony to win the game in a single turn. The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Duress and Thoughtseize while searching for combo pieces with cards like Wishclaw Talisman and Infernal Tutor. Urza's Saga can help find key artifacts like Defense Grid or Shadowspear to protect the combo. The deck aims to win through a storm mechanic, generating multiple spells in a single turn to overwhelm the opponent.
